max_jobs.description: How many projects slice at once.

timeout_minutes.description: How long one slicer run may take.

memory_mib.description: The memory one slicer run may hold, in MiB, derived from the host's memory budget and max_jobs. Read only. 0 means the host set no budget.

threads.description: The threads one slicer run may use. 0 lets the slicer choose.

max_project_mib.description: The largest project a job takes, in MiB.

max_upload_bytes.description: The largest project POST /jobs/upload takes, in bytes.

Status.description: Whether the module can slice, and its bounds.

ready.description: Whether the host has sent the settings.

problem.description: Why the module cannot slice, when it cannot.

selections.description: Whether this build slices a chosen bed or chosen objects.

jobs.description: How many jobs are in each state.

channel.description: Whether it is a final release.

source.description: Where it came from: the GitHub manifest, the operator's manifest, or a binary the operator named in local_binaries.

sha256.description: The digest of the download it was unpacked from. Empty for a local binary.

verified.description: Whether the download matched a SHA-256 its source published. An administrator confirmed an install without one.

released.description: The day the release was published, when its manifest says.

notes.description: The address of the release's notes, when its manifest names one.

bytes.description: The room it takes on disk.

path.description: The executable on this server. Only an administrator is told it.

Offer.description: One release: a build this server can install, or a release in the supported range it cannot, with the reason.

channel.description: Whether it is a final release.

source.description: Where it is offered: the GitHub releases or the operator's manifest.

size.description: The size of the download in bytes, when its source says.

asset.description: The file name of the download.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 its source published for the download, lowercase hex. Absent when it published none.

verified.description: Whether the download is checked against a SHA-256 its source published. Installing one that is not takes a confirmation.

compatible.description: Whether this server can install it.

reason.description: Why this server cannot install it.

released.description: The day the release was published, when the manifest says.

notes.description: The address of the release's notes, when the manifest names one.

installed.description: Whether this version is installed from a manifest.

Catalogue.description: Where the GitHub release list stands.

github.description: Whether the GitHub releases are offered.

fetched_at.description: When the list was read from GitHub.

error.description: Why the last reading failed. The list read before is still offered.

supported.description: The range of versions this module offers, such as >=2.7.0 <4.0.0.

InstallProgress.description: One install that is running or failed.

done_bytes.description: How much of the download arrived.

total_bytes.description: How large the download is, when known.

SettingProblem.description: A setting the module could not use, such as a local binary that named no version.

Slicers.description: Every slicer the module knows about.

platform.description: This server's operating system and processor, such as linux/arm64.

installed.description: The slicers a job can run, newest first.

available.description: The builds the manifests offer for this server, newest first.

installing.description: The installs that are running or failed.

pinned.description: The version an administrator chose as the default.

default.description: The version a job that names none gets. Empty when nothing is installed.

problems.description: The settings the module could not use.

stl_profiles.description: The names of the saved profiles an STL job can use.

prepare_beds.description: Rectangular print volumes indexed by saved STL profile name.

prepare_settings.description: The starting print settings, indexed by saved STL profile name.

unverified.description: Confirms the install of a release that publishes no SHA-256, whose download cannot be checked.

version.description: The version, such as 2.9.6. An empty version clears the default.

Selection.description: What a job slices: one bed of one printer setup and the build items on it. A build item is one placed copy of an object, counted from 0 in the order of the project's build list.

setup.description: The printer setup. A PrusaSlicer 2 project has one, setup 0.

items.description: The build items to print. Empty is every printable item on the bed.

positions.description: Copies of build items to put on the bed, instead of items. The first position of an item moves it there, and each further one adds a copy. The project's settings are kept.

Position.description: One copy of a build item on the bed.

item.description: The build item whose copy is placed.

x.description: Where the centre of the item's box stands, in millimetres from the origin of the bed shape.

y.description: The same, along the depth of the bed.

rotate.description: How far the copy turns about the vertical axis through the centre of the item's box, in degrees counterclockwise. 0 keeps it as the item stands.

upload.description: The file name of an uploaded project. Empty for one in a storage.

storage.description: The storage. Empty is the storage of the project.

path.description: The file inside it, without an extension. The module writes into its folder a name that starts with eight characters of a hash of the storage and this path, so a printer's FAT short names tell outputs apart. Then come a dash, this path's own name, and .bgcode or .gcode for what the slicer wrote. The result names the file. Empty is the project's own path.

SubmitBody.description: A project in a storage to slice.

slicer.description: The version to slice with. Empty is the default.

format.description: Binary or text G-code. Empty keeps what the project says.

overwrite.description: Replace a file of the same name. Without it, a job whose file exists fails.

profile.description: The saved profile name for an STL job.

keep_placement.description: Keep the XY coordinates of an STL model on the build plate.

log.description: The end of what the slicer printed, when it ran.

existing.description: With server-slicing/OUTPUT_EXISTS, the file that is there already. It is the file the job would have written.

storage.description: The storage the file is in.

path.description: The file, with its folder and extension.

JobObject.description: One object the G-code labels, which a printer can cancel on its own.

id.description: The number the G-code labels it with, M486 S<id>.

item.description: The build item of the project it came from, when the module could tell.

instance.description: The object and the copy of it that the build item is.

object.description: The object's index in the project.

instance.description: The copy's index in that object.

polygon.description: Its outline on the bed it was sliced on, in millimetres.

Point.description: A point on the bed, in millimetres.

JobResult.description: The G-code a job wrote and what it says about the print.

peak_memory_bytes.description: The most memory the slicer held, where the server can read it.

estimated_seconds.description: The print time the slicer estimated.

filament_mm.description: The filament the print uses, in millimetres.

filament_g.description: The filament the print uses, in grams.

printer_model.description: The printer it was sliced for, such as MK4S.

objects.description: The objects a printer can cancel one by one.

thumbnails.description: The pictures the file carries. The slicer copies them from the project.

warnings.description: What went differently from what was asked.

progress.description: From 0 to 100, and -1 while the slicer says nothing about how far it is.

slicer.description: The version asked for, or the one chosen once the job runs.

overwrite.description: Whether a file of the same name is replaced.

profile.description: The saved profile name for an STL job.

keep_placement.description: Keep the XY coordinates of an STL model on the build plate.

JobList.description: One page of jobs, newest first.

total.description: How many jobs the filter matched.

all.description: Whether the list holds every person's jobs, which an administrator sees.

Refusal.description: One refusal, as RFC 9457 names it. The client SDK reads this shape: code reaches ApiError.code and detail reaches ApiError.message.

type.description: about:blank, because this module publishes no page per code.

status.description: The HTTP status, repeated in the body.

code.description: The module's own code. It is outside the core's registry, so it starts with the module's short name.

title.description: What went wrong, in one English phrase that never varies.

retryable.description: Whether sending the same request again could work.

STLBed.description: A rectangular print volume in millimetres.

PrintSettings.description: Settings that change a saved STL profile for one job. An absent field keeps the profile's value.

layer_height_mm.description: The layer height in millimetres. A layer thicker than the nozzle is wide fails in the slicer.

walls.description: How many perimeters each layer has.

supports.description: Where the slicer may add support material: nowhere, only where it stands on the build plate, or everywhere.

brim_width_mm.description: The width of the brim around the first layer, in millimetres. 0 prints no brim.

ProfileSettings.description: What a saved STL profile prints with before a person changes anything. A value the profile does not state is absent.

filament_type.description: The material of the profile's first extruder, such as PETG.

waiting.description: The number of waiting entries when Print queue returns its updated queue.

bearer.description: An API credential this server issued, sent as a bearer token. Its scope decides which routes it reaches: read for a GET, operate for anything else, and administer for the routes that change the installed slicers.

session.name: pcl_session
session.description: The session a browser holds after it signs in to this server.

post.summary: Slice a project in a storage
post.description: Takes a job that slices one 3MF project a storage holds. The module reads the project as the caller and asks whether the caller may write into the target storage before it takes the job. The answer comes at once, with the job queued. A worker slices it later as the module, and asks the server again whether the caller may still read and write before it does. The host takes operate_resource on the module's instance before this is called, which a credential with the operate scope reaches.

post.description: Reads the PrusaSlicer release list from the GitHub Releases API again, with the ETag of the copy on disk.
